claim: Simple mode is the default landing page, with newer analyses on their own sub-tabs, and renders from the production build: briefing strip, 13 smart tiles with graphics and data-age badges, twelve sourced tabs including the on-demand Compare states ranking, draft targets and How measured pop-ups with no not-loaded or hand-entered labels, a 120-county map with drill-down, the plan scorecard, pins and the tile catalog, first-visit explainer pop-ups that play their video and honor Don’t show again, and no horizontal overflow on a phone.
assertions: A bare URL lands on the simple view; the left nav shows the fourteen simple tabs plus SME view.
Simple nav tabs are a compact list (37px tall each).
The left nav lists 22 sub-tabs under their tabs; choosing one opens it on the page, and choosing a page sub-tab highlights it in the nav.
Renders 13 dashboard tiles on At a glance.
Briefing strip renders 6 open questions with owner and next action.
Every dashboard tile renders a smart-tile graphic.
The renewals trend tile spans two columns, and the briefing strip sits below the dashboard.
Renders 13 data-age badges on dashboard tiles.
Every dashboard tile shows its data age, the page states its newest and oldest data, and the targets bar says demo mode (#3, #7).
A dashboard tile opens its page scrolled to the linked section.
All fourteen tabs render with no "not loaded yet" or "entered by hand" text.
Renders 1 Kentucky row on the state ranking.
Renders 46 state columns in the horizontal view.
Compare states loads on demand and shows 46 states as columns, then the long ranked list, on a KRS 7A.287 Core Set measure with Kentucky highlighted (#20).
A draft target shows on its card with the gap, and "How measured" opens its pop-up (#7, #14).
Access page shows the rural panel and the deprivation payment scenario responds to its slider (#12, #6).
Renders 3 margin thirds.
Hospitals tab shows margin thirds, commercial prices against Medicare and the hospital list (#9, #2).
Payment rates tab shows Medicare by payment area, Medicaid as a percent of Medicare like for like, spreads, and T-MSIS procedure codes across states (#22, #24, #11, #21).
Health plans tab shows the contract ledger (#10).
Renders 120 county paths on the county tab.
County tab: clicking Jefferson County opens its breakdown.
Zip map: zooms to Jefferson County, combines three West Louisville zip codes, and the Health outcomes page shows CDC estimates for that area (#1, #8).
Renders 4 vulnerability quarters.
Access page compares an access measure across social vulnerability quarters of counties (#23).
Renders 4 deprivation quarters with the SDI chosen.
Vulnerability overlay: 36 shortage counties outlined on the SVI map; the SDI can replace the SVI; the rural outline marks 81 counties; SVI/SDI disagreements are listed.
The Estimate pill and the ? button open their pop-ups (method; source with link).
My district: clicking a county selects its district, split counties list their districts, and the House/Senate switch keeps the place.
My district: the map switches to social vulnerability and the panel shows the district’s resident-weighted SVI and SDI.
Renders 4 deprivation quarters on the payments view.
Payment rates: the deprivation view shows four quarters and a plain-language finding; Medicaid vs Medicare names its bundle; spreads and T-MSIS pass through the normalization rules.
Hospitals: commercial prices shown in dollars per inpatient stay for 50 hospitals.
Renders 6 plan rows on the scorecard.
SME view is headed by "Back to simple view", which returns to the simple tab last used (Health plans) (#18).
Pinning moves a tile first; Customize opens the tile catalog.
Renders 3 card-feature videos offered on At a glance.
First visit to Compare states offers the explainer; Watch plays explainers/decisionpro-compare-states.mp4 (42 s, 1280 px wide).
Renders 0 explainer dialogs after Don’t show again.
Renders 0 explainer dialogs on a tab turned off.
Renders 0 explainer dialogs on a tab already watched.
Don’t show again keeps the Rate spreads pop-up off; a watched explainer is not offered again; "How this works" stays on both tabs.
Shareable links: four page/tab links open their sub-tab after sign-in, and moving to another sub-tab rewrites the URL.
Renders 0 video offers in Explain this Page on a tab with no explainer.
Explain this Page describes the simple tab and sub-tab on screen, plays its explainer video, and offers none where none exists.
Renders 1 explainer offer on a shared link to rates/deprivation.
Renders 1 explainer offer on a shared link to access/vulnerability.
Renders 1 explainer offer on a shared link to county/zips.
Renders 1 explainer offer on a shared link to hospitals/prices.
Renders 1 explainer offer on a shared link to home/-.
A first-time viewer opening a shared link is offered that page’s explainer video (five links checked, one played).
No horizontal overflow at a 390 px phone width.
